title: Hyte Y70 Touch Infinite Xbox Controller Holder
author: rickey527
description:
Boost Me (for free)

If you really wanna get in the game, hit that boost button and lets go!

Boost

!!!Please read!!!  Apparently for one user this didn't work and it just falls off. If this is the case, use some 2-sided tape to hold it on. Mine has been on for over a month now but I'm assuming that due to different qualities of prints and printer differences you may have issues with it staying on without some tape.

A convenient spot to hold my controller when not in use on my PC case. The case is the Hyte Y70 Touch infinte and I used the slots on top to position the controller holder. I added a little logo on the front as well which does greatly increase print time but I think it looks great. I will say if you're worried about it falling, maybe add some 2-sided tape. Mine has been on a few days though and so far it's solid just from the friction from the 3 rectangular pieces inside the slots. As for the print orientation, it's odd, but this position is the only way I got it to work without the rectangular pieces being a mess causing it to not fit. Maybe your printer is more tuned and you can get it to work at another angle. If so, feel free to upload your print profile for others. As always, enjoy and thank you for your support on my printing journey.
